caption: The drawing is a monochromatic, pencil-rendered illustration featuring multiple views and details of an ornate lidded vessel. The main, centrally-located object is a large, urn-shaped container with a flared base and a wide, scalloped brim. The vessel's surface is elaborately decorated with a repeating floral and foliate pattern around its widest circumference. The domed lid is topped with a sculpted bird as a finial, and the lid's edge mirrors the vessel's decorative motifs. To the right, there is a top-down view of the lid, clearly displaying the bird in the center and the circular ornamental patterns surrounding it, as well as the scalloped edge. Below this view, a horizontal strip presents a close-up of the floral and foliate design repeated on the vessel. In the upper left corner, there is a small inset showing a simple line schematic with measurements of the entire vessel with the lid and bird finial. The overall composition is evenly spaced, and the monochrome pencil shading gives the objects a metallic appearance. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
